summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only regression + delta verification for IT SMARTCLOUT. All new Hero topology testids present (hero-topology, topo-node-core, topo-node-server/storage/network/dr/backup/security). Central hub renders label 'DATACENTER'. Hovering topo-node-storage adds 'is-hovered' class as expected. Backward-compat hero-node-0..6 chips all still present. Hero title in PL is 'Infrastruktura IT stworzona dla ciągłości Twojego biznesu' and switches to EN 'IT infrastructure built for the continuity of your business'. About section has all 3 metric cards (20+, 500+, 130+), 3 clickable pillars (about-pillar-listen/holistic/optimize) with 'holistic' active by default; clicking listen/optimize activates them (is-active class) and updates the hex core label to 'Uważność'/'Optymalizacja'. Hex SVG is present inside .sc-about-graphic. All 6 sections still render (hero, about, trusted, portfolio, partners, contact). Contact form POST /api/contact returned 200 in the browser flow and success toast appeared. No page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: DatacenterTopology.jsx: onMouseLeave resets `hovered` to null but keeps `clicked` state — good pattern for keeping selection sticky after click. However, the two states can visually collide (hover on a different node while another is clicked keeps both is-hovered). Consider a single `focus` state or make clicked act as an ARIA-selected item for clarity.
DatacenterTopology.jsx nodes are rendered as `<button>` but only aria-label is provided in EN even when lang==='pl' — consider passing localized aria-label (n.label_pl when lang==='pl').

AboutSection.jsx: setActive is triggered on both onMouseEnter and onClick — on touch/mobile onMouseEnter can fire before click and cause a flicker; consider gating onMouseEnter behind a `matchMedia('(hover: hover)')` check.

AboutSection.jsx PILLARS array + HexInfographic component (~150 lines) could be extracted to /components/sections/AboutPillars.jsx for readability (file currently ~305 lines, still under 700 threshold).
HeroSection.jsx legend hard-codes '99.99% dostępność / uptime' — if this is a marketing claim it should live in the i18n dictionary alongside t.hero for consistency.
server.py (unchanged from iter1): created_at stored as ISO string; consider storing native BSON datetime for cleaner sort semantics.

success_rate.backend: 100% (regression via UI POST /api/contact = 200; pytest suite already 8/8 in iter1, not re-run per instructions)
